userStories.title: Define DeepSeek config, effort translation, and capabilities
userStories.description: As an operator, I want validated DeepSeek configuration schemas, reasoning effort mapping, and provider capability declarations, so that unsupported options fail fast before execution.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/types.ts exports DeepseekProviderDefaults containing optional model, baseUrl, providerRoute, profile ('acp'), permissionMode ('workspace-write' | 'danger-full-access'), effort, and nodeBin (omitting maxTokens).

packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/capabilities.ts exports DEEPSEEK_CAPABILITIES with sessionResume: true, mcp: true, envInjection: true, effortControl: true, structuredOutput: 'best-effort', and all other axes false.

packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/config.ts exports DEFAULT_DEEPSEEK_PROFILE ('acp'), DEFAULT_DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_ROUTE ('deepseek-official'), DEFAULT_DEEPSEEK_PERMISSION_MODE ('workspace-write'), parseDeepseekConfig, and resolveDeepseekEffort.

parseDeepseekConfig trims strings, requires http: or https: for baseUrl, rejects profile other than acp, restricts permissionMode to workspace-write or danger-full-access, rejects providerRoute without model, and rejects maxTokens !== undefined with an error naming the unsupported pinned ACP surface.
resolveDeepseekEffort maps minimal->off, medium->low, xhigh->high, preserves off, low, high, max, and rejects unknown or blank values.
packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/config.test.ts tests all config validation and effort mapping cases and passes via bun test src/community/deepseek/config.test.ts.

userStories.title: Translate ACP session updates without fabricating usage
userStories.description: As a stream consumer, I want ACP session updates translated into Archon MessageChunks with stateful tool call tracking, so that assistant thoughts and tool events stream faithfully without false token or cost usage.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/event-bridge.ts exports createDeepseekEventState and mapDeepseekSessionUpdate(update: SessionUpdate, state: DeepseekEventState): MessageChunk[].
agent_message_chunk maps to assistant chunk, agent_thought_chunk maps to thinking chunk, and non-text message content is ignored.
tool_call emits tool chunk with name ?? title, toolCallId, and object rawInput (non-object wrapped in { rawInput: value }).
tool_call_update preserves name and input during in-progress updates, extracts content or JSON-serialized rawOutput upon completion, and deletes stored state upon terminal update.
Completed update maps to toolOutcome: 'success'; failed update maps to toolOutcome: 'error'.
Tool result in pinned DSH structure ({ content: [{ type: 'content', content: { type: 'text', text: '...' } }] }) extracts the text string correctly.
usage_update, plans, modes, config updates, session info, compaction, and user message updates emit zero chunks, never generating tokens, usageBreakdown, or cost.
packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/event-bridge.test.ts passes via bun test src/community/deepseek/event-bridge.test.ts.

userStories.title: Validate and convert per-node MCP declarations
userStories.description: As a workflow author, I want Archon MCP server configurations strictly validated and converted into ACP declarations, so that stdio and HTTP MCP servers are forwarded to DSH and unsupported SSE fails fast.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/mcp.ts exports buildDeepseekMcpServers(servers: Record<string, unknown>, env: Record<string, string>): McpServer[].
Defaults omitted type to stdio; validates non-empty command, string args, and string env.
Resolves bare stdio commands through supplied PATH using which or where; unresolved bare command throws deepseek_mcp_config_error naming server and command.
Formats stdio output as { name, command: absolutePath, args, env: [{ name, value }] }.
Validates HTTP transport requiring absolute http: or https: URL and converts headers to { name, value }[].
Rejects SSE transport with deepseek_mcp_config_error stating pinned DSH ACP supports only stdio and Streamable HTTP.
Rejects unknown transports, malformed objects, and blank names; does not mutate input objects.
packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/mcp.test.ts passes via bun test src/community/deepseek/mcp.test.ts.

userStories.title: Implement async callback-to-generator queue
userStories.description: As an ACP client engineer, I want an async queue bridging push callbacks to an async iterable, so that streaming notifications can be iterated cleanly with deterministic buffering and teardown.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/async-queue.ts exports AsyncQueue<T> implementing AsyncIterable<T>.
push(value: T) appends value in FIFO order, immediately resolving any awaiting reader.
close() drains buffered values before completing with done: true.
fail(error: unknown) drains buffered values before rejecting with the stored error.
close() and fail() are idempotent; push() after terminal state throws.
packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/async-queue.test.ts passes via bun test src/community/deepseek/async-queue.test.ts.

userStories.title: Drive complete ACP turn lifecycle and process cleanup
userStories.description: As a provider runner, I want a client managing the full ACP handshake, prompt, cancel, close, and process reaping, so that DSH sessions execute reliably without orphan processes.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/acp-client.ts exports DeepseekAcpTurnInput, driveDeepseekAcpTurn, DeepseekProcessInput, DeepseekProcessDependencies, and runDeepseekAcpTurn.
Uses fluent client({ name: 'archon-deepseek' }) API, auto-answering permission requests with answerDeepseekPermissionRequest() and queuing session update notifications via AsyncQueue.
Requests initialize with PROTOCOL_VERSION; requires agentCapabilities to include resume and close, and requires http MCP capability if HTTP MCP servers are declared.
Calls session/new for fresh turns and session/resume for resumed turns; rejects failed resume with deepseek_resume_failed without calling session/new.
Sets model (configId: 'model', value: JSON.stringify([providerRoute, model])) and reasoning effort (configId: 'reasoning_effort') when configured.
Augments outbound prompt with augmentPromptForJsonSchema when outputSchema is provided, and parses assistant transcript with tryParseStructuredOutput upon turn completion.
Listens to AbortSignal, sends cancel via ctx.notify(methods.agent.session.cancel, ...), requests session/close, and emits local result chunk with stopReason: 'aborted'.
Always requests session/close after every created or resumed session.

runDeepseekAcpTurn spawns <node> <dshEntrypoint> --profile acp, binds stdio to ndJsonStream, caps stderr at 4096 characters, and reaps the child in finally via SIGTERM with SIGKILL escalation (terminateGraceMs default 2000ms, injectable 0ms).
packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/acp-client.test.ts passes against in-process fake ACP agent via bun test src/community/deepseek/acp-client.test.ts.

userStories.title: Implement DeepSeekProvider boundary with error-as-result semantics
userStories.description: As a workflow executor, I want DeepSeekProvider to implement IAgentProvider with error-as-result conversion and lazy loading, so that execution errors never crash the host and ACP code loads on demand.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/provider.ts implements IAgentProvider as DeepseekProvider.
getType() returns 'deepseek' and getCapabilities() returns DEEPSEEK_CAPABILITIES.
Supports injected DeepseekProviderDependencies (runTurn, resolveNodeBinary, resolveDshEntrypoint); in production, sendQuery() dynamically imports ./acp-client.
Pre-aborted signal yields one deepseek_aborted error result without invoking preflight or spawning DSH.
Preflight resolves options.model ?? config.model, options.nodeConfig?.effort ?? config.effort, and loads MCP passing merged { ...process.env, ...requestOptions.env }.
Resumed turns wrap runner stream with withResumedOutcome to stamp resumed: true on the result chunk.
Failed resume yields exactly one terminal deepseek_resume_failed error result and never retries.
Outer try/catch converts all thrown errors via toDeepseekErrorResult redacting the resolved API key.
Result chunks never synthesize tokens, usageBreakdown, or cost.
packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/provider.test.ts passes via bun test src/community/deepseek/provider.test.ts.
